name: motif_edit_natural_class_features
description:
Edit a natural class's features. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation; check best practice. Use only if a class defined by features picks the wrong sounds; otherwise use compose-edit-natural-class for a class defined by segments. Every rule and environment using it changes too (guide nasal-assimilation). Stages a change to the feature values that define a feature-based natural class: set a constraint (a feature the class already constrains takes the new value in place) and clear constraints. The class must keep at least one constraint, and a segment class is refused. The response lists the environments, rules and insertions that use the class. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-edit-natural-class-features. Agent class: Draft.

target.description: Id of the existing feature-based natural class.

set.description: Feature and value pairs to set, each an object with feature and value ids.

clear.description: Ids of features whose constraint is removed.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
